schema.name: XposedOrNotBreachCatalog_CL
schema.description: XposedOrNot breach catalog with breach date, password risk and exposed data types. Each poll writes a full snapshot.

columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.description: Time the record was ingested into the workspace.

columns.name: AddedDate
columns.description: Date the breach was added to XposedOrNot.

columns.name: PasswordRisk
columns.description: Password risk level: plaintext, easytocrack, hardtocrack or unknown.

columns.name: ExposedData
columns.description: List of data types exposed in the breach.

columns.name: ExposedRecords
columns.description: Total number of records exposed in the breach.

columns.name: IsSearchable
columns.description: Whether the breach is searchable in XposedOrNot.

columns.name: IsSensitive
columns.description: Whether the breach is flagged as sensitive.
